name: Source: Pakistan
notes: Official figures are downloaded from the publishers' own data services and calculated by code; interim figures are read from SBP, PBS, Finance Ministry and FBR releases, market closes, and news reports of them. Every figure shows its source.
takeaway: Inflation of 10.3% is well above the State Bank's 5–7% target, so the policy rate is back up at 12.00%. Buffers are thicker, with SBP reserves at $21.52bn, but the current account has slipped back into deficit: −$874m in July–September.

curve.note: Cut-off yields from the 28 Oct T-bill auction, after the October rate hike, compared with the 16 Sep auction. Bond yields are from the 18 Sep PIB auction, the latest the State Bank has published results for.
